items.reason: The marked proprietary, nonpublic technical specifications are Confidential Information. Meridian received them from Larch, and no stated exception applies. The clause expressly prohibits disclosure to third parties, including subsidiaries, and an unrelated-project bid is not performance under the Agreement.

The proprietary, nonpublic formula is Confidential Information received from Vale. Although it became public, that occurred through Harbor's unauthorized publication, so the public-domain exception does not apply. Harbor remains prohibited from divulging it to the customer.

The oral disclosure was not summarized in a writing submitted within 30 days: the first stated written summary was submitted 35 days after September 1. The oral-disclosure exception therefore applies, so the confidentiality obligation does not prohibit the planned description.

Elm's contemporary November 2024 notebook and CAD file establish prior possession of the identical geometry before Northstar's disclosure and without acquisition from Northstar. The geometry was also independently developed. Either stated exception removes the obligation as to Elm's own November CAD file.
The drawing has 12 pages and the spreadsheet has 8 pages; 12 minus 8 is 4. Whether either item is Confidential Information cannot affect that arithmetic result.

The tooling blueprint was sent on March 18, 2025, while the pricing workbook was sent on March 19, 2025. The blueprint was sent earlier, not later; confidentiality classification cannot affect the date comparison.
